title: Check the omitted Spring hierarchy edge on both original managers
description: On the Spring Security #14196 pre-feature and landed artifacts, compare four public manager calls per prefix. Starting with A, remove the B-to-D edge after checking the full hierarchy. D alone must still grant on the reduced graph, and C alone must decline on the full graph. Qualify each ordinary native proof and physical JVM replay on the original ordered classpath.
expected: Both JARs produce decision bits 1,0,1,0 for ROLE_ and CUSTOM_PREFIX_. Four strict native checks establish mask 5, binding the actual public caller, manager and hierarchy classes.
